articles.title: GTA 6: So machst du PS5 & Xbox fit für den 200-GB-Giganten
articles.text:
Platz für GTA 6: Die besten Speicher-Upgrades für PS5 und Xbox
Hinweis: Wir haben in diesem Artikel Provisions-Links verwendet und sie durch "*" gekennzeichnet. Erfolgt über diese Links eine Bestellung, erhält t3n.de eine Provision.
Am 19. November 2026 erscheint GTA 6. Fans der Reihe mussten sich lange gedulden, denn die Veröffentlichung des Vorgängers liegt mehr als 13 Jahre zurück. Während die Vorfreude steigt, machen neue Details allerdings klar, dass das Spiel die bisherige Hardware an ihre Grenzen bringen könnte – auch beim Speicherplatz. Wir erklären dir, wie groß der Download des langersehnten Spiels ausfallen könnte und mit welchen externen Festplatten du deine Konsole aufrüstest.
Speicherlösungen für PS5 und Xbox bei GTA 6
Mehrere Medien, darunter Yahoo Tech, berichten, dass der Download von GTA 6 über 200 Gigabyte groß sein soll. Grund dafür könnten das aufwendige Design und das immersive Spielerlebnis sein. Rockstar Games hat den Umfang bisher zwar nicht offiziell bestätigt, aber auch frühere Titel brauchten viel Platz. So kam beispielsweise Red Dead Redemption 2 auf rund 125 Gigabyte. Der interne Speicher von Playstation- und Xbox-Konsolen ist allerdings begrenzt. Oft startet er bei einem Terabyte, die kompaktere Xbox Series S gibt es sogar mit nur 512 Gigabyte. Der tatsächlich freie Speicher fällt noch geringer aus, weil die Konsole einen Teil für das Betriebssystem und weitere Systemfunktionen reserviert. Wenn du ein Spiel wie GTA 6 installieren willst, wird es also schnell eng.
Unter den Pioneers Picks stellen wir dir regelmäßig weitere praktische Tools und Gadgets vor.
Die gute Nachricht ist, dass du deine Konsole um eine externe Festplatte oder SSD erweitern kannst. Dabei gibt es aber einiges zu beachten. Anders als bei älteren Konsolen kannst du Spiele für die Playstation 5 nämlich nicht direkt auf einem externen USB-Speicher zocken. Der Grund: Diese bieten nicht die nötige Geschwindigkeit. Zum Spielen müssen die Games also zuerst auf den internen Speicher der Konsole kopiert werden. Eine externe Festplatte oder SSD dient bei der Playstation 5 daher eher als Archiv für Spiele, die du länger nicht gezockt hast, und schafft Platz auf der internen Festplatte.
Xbox Series X und S mit Speichererweiterungskarten aufrüsten
Auch bei der Xbox hängt die Nutzung eines externen Speichers von der Konsolengeneration ab. Bei älteren Modellen kannst du direkt von einer externen Festplatte oder SSD spielen. Bei der Xbox Series X und Series S geht das nicht. Eine Ausnahme bildet die externe Speichererweiterungskarte: Sie wurde in Zusammenarbeit mit Xbox entwickelt und bietet ein nahtloses Spielerlebnis, weil du hier Games direkt von der Karte starten und spielen kannst. Sie ist so konzipiert, dass sie die gleiche Speicherleistung wie die interne SSD bietet. Laut Herstellerangaben sorgt eine Übertragungsrate von 3.000 Megabyte pro Sekunde für schnelle Ladezeiten und geringe Latenzen. Du steckst die Karte auf der Rückseite der Xbox direkt in den dafür vorgesehenen Steckplatz. Das Modell von Seagate ist mit einem oder zwei Terabyte erhältlich. Bei Amazon kostet es ab 282,99 Euro.
Seagate Game Drive als externe Festplatte für PS5 und Xbox
Sony bietet selbst einige externe Speicheroptionen an, die auf die Playstation 5 optimiert sind. Eine davon ist der Game Drive von Seagate. Der Durchmesser des Geräts beträgt 2,5 Zoll. Das Design ist der Konsole angepasst – inklusive Logo. Die externe Festplatte ist mit zwei oder fünf Terabyte erhältlich und bietet somit ausreichend Platz, um ältere Spiele zu archivieren oder überall hin mitzunehmen. Du schließt sie per USB-3.0-Schnittstelle direkt an die Konsole an. Ein erneutes Herunterladen entfällt somit. Bei Amazon kostet die kleinere Variante aktuell 150,99 Euro. Das gleiche Modell gibt es auch für die Xbox mit der klassischen schwarzen Optik der Microsoft-Konsole. Es ist mit zwei, acht und 20 Terabyte verfügbar, der Preis startet bei 128,99 Euro.
- Seagate Game Drive für Playstation 5 bei Amazon*
- Seagate Game Drive für Xbox Series X und Series S bei Amazon*
Sandisk Extreme Portable SSD für die Playstation 5
Auch Sandisk bietet externen Speicher, der offiziell für die Playstation 5 lizenziert ist. Die SSD misst ebenfalls 2,5 Zoll und orientiert sich mit ihrer weißen Farbe am Design der Sony-Konsole. Laut Hersteller bietet sie eine hohe Geschwindigkeit von bis zu 1.000 Megabyte pro Sekunde, um Spiele schnell vom externen SSD-Archiv auf den internen Speicher der Playstation 5 zu übertragen. Zudem ist sie besonders robust: Sie bietet IP65-Schutz und ist fallsicher aus bis zu drei Metern Höhe. Wie die Seagate-Festplatte schließt du die SSD per USB an die Konsole an. Das Modell gibt es mit einem oder zwei Terabyte Speicherplatz. Bei Amazon kostet es ab 200,99 Euro. Laut etablierten Preisvergleichsportalen ist das aktuell das günstigste Angebot. Trotzdem kann es sich lohnen, mit dem Kauf noch etwas zu warten, denn bis vor Kurzem war die SSD schon ab 179 Euro erhältlich.

articles.title: The man behind Wind Mobile is bringing a new carrier to Canada
articles.text:
The man behind Wind Mobile wants to bring a new wireless carrier to Canada amid ongoing attempts by other providers to consolidate the telecom market.
Anthony Lacavera, the founder and chairman of Toronto-based investment firm Globalive, announced plans to re-enter the Canadian wireless market with a new provider called Paradise Mobile. Backed by Globalive, Paradise Mobile currently operates in Bermuda using a “cloud-native Open RAN 5G network” using in-house AI tools to “automate network operations and improve performance.”
Notably, Lacavera cited awards from Ookla’s Speedtest, which named Paradise as Bermuda’s fastest network in 2025 and 2026. In 2025, Paradise had a median download speed of 376.6Mbps, significantly higher than Bell, often named one of Canada’s fastest networks, with an average speed of 107.5Mbps. Of course, Bermuda is significantly smaller than Canada, so these types of one-to-one comparisons shouldn’t be taken at face value.
Beyond speed, Lacavera pitched a pure wireless play, arguing that Canada’s other national carriers also sell cable, home internet, TV, and other services.
“None of them has a reason to disrupt wireless when doing so risks cannibalizing revenue from their existing customers and legacy businesses. A pure-play operator has one job: win customers with better service and lower prices. That is how Canadian prices come down to global levels,” Lacavera said.
Further, Lacavera said Canada has sky-high wireless rates, which remain among the highest in the world. He argued the only way to lower these prices is by making room for new independent players, especially if something like Quebecor’s bid to buy Telus goes through.
Freedom Mobile owner Quebecor launched an unsolicited bid to acquire the Vancouver-based telecom earlier this month. CEO Pierre Karl Péladeau argued that combining the companies would give them the strength to fight off foreign competition, such as from Elon Musk’s Starlink. Quebecor’s proposal spurred Bell to launch its own bid for Telus — which Quebecor was quick to say would harm competition, as if its own Telus takeover would be any better. And while everyone with a memory long enough to remember the Rogers-Shaw merger knows this would be a bad idea, Prime Minister Mark Carney said that oligopolies “can lead to more competition.” Yeah, sure bud.
Interestingly, Freedom Mobile was once Lacavera’s Wind Mobile before it was acquired by Shaw for $1.6 billion in 2016. As part of Rogers’ acquisition of Shaw in 2023, Freedom was sold to Quebecor for $2.85 billion. However, Lacavera pointed out that Globalive also sought to reacquire Freedom in 2022 for $3.75 billion.
Lacavera told the Globe and Mail that Globalive would attempt to reacquire Freedom Mobile from Quebecor should its bid for Telus go through. He also expressed interest in purchasing assets divested by Bell should it be the one to acquire Telus.
Globalive said its Canada re-entry strategy includes acquiring wireless assets, spectrum, customer base, and retail operations. The company also plans to explore spectrum and network-sharing arrangements and will participate in future federal spectrum auctions.

articles.title: La reflexión de Albert Einstein sobre las personas independientes: "La monotonía y la soledad de una vida tranquila estimulan la mente creativa"
articles.text:
Albert Einstein tenía una propuesta bastante peculiar para los jóvenes que querían dedicarse a la ciencia: trabajar en un faro. No lo decía de broma. En octubre de 1933, durante una intervención en Londres, el físico defendió que algunos empleos tranquilos podían ser una buena alternativa para quienes necesitaban tiempo libre para investigar. Su preocupación era que muchos científicos estuvieran demasiado ocupados intentando ganarse la vida.
En aquella conferencia también habló de su propia experiencia viviendo apartado en el campo. Fue entonces cuando explicó que había comprobado cómo "la monotonía de una vida tranquila estimula la mente creativa". La frase, recuperada por OKDIARIO en un artículo sobre las personas independientes, resumía algo que Einstein valoraba especialmente: poder dedicar horas a pensar sin demasiadas interrupciones.
Por qué Einstein prefería un faro a una beca de investigación
El científico consideraba que trabajar en un faro podía dejar tiempo suficiente para estudiar matemáticas o filosofía. La idea tenía su lógica: en lugar de depender de una beca de investigación, un joven podría tener un empleo con el que mantenerse y reservar parte del día para desarrollar sus propios proyectos.
Einstein también cuestionó las dificultades que encontraban quienes recibían ayudas para investigar. A su juicio, la obligación de presentar resultados en periodos demasiado cortos podía perjudicar trabajos que necesitaban años de dedicación. Por eso pensaba que disponer de tranquilidad y cierta independencia económica podía ser más útil de lo que parecía.
Aquella propuesta no llegó a convertirse en un sistema de empleo para investigadores, pero tampoco fue una ocurrencia aislada. Einstein ya había defendido anteriormente la posibilidad de combinar un trabajo remunerado con la investigación científica. En su intervención de 1933 volvió a plantear esa alternativa, esta vez con un oficio muy concreto: cuidar de un faro.

articles.title: Microsoft removes WSUS server role in Windows Server 2028
articles.text:
Microsoft will remove the WSUS server role from Windows Server 2028, the next major release of its server operating system.
Introduced in 2005 as Software Update Services (SUS), WSUS (Windows Server Update Services) lets IT administrators manage and distribute updates for Microsoft products across corporate networks with many Windows devices.
It gives admins centralized control over the updates, rather than having each device download them individually from Microsoft's servers.
Microsoft has officially deprecated WSUS in September 2024, but said that it still plans to maintain functionality and continue publishing updates through the channel. The change affects enterprise environments that rely on WSUS to manage updates delivered to many devices but does not impact home users or those using Microsoft Configuration Manager.
In a recently updated support document, Microsoft went even further and confirmed that Windows Server 2028 removes the WSUS server role altogether.
"WSUS remains available and supported in earlier Windows Server releases, including Windows Server 2025, for the duration of each release's support lifecycle. You can continue to use WSUS on those releases to manage updates for supported Windows client and Windows Server releases, which includes updates to Windows Server 2028," it said.
"Microsoft recognizes the need to manage updates in disconnected and highly controlled environments. We're invested in supporting these scenarios and we'll share more as the work progresses."
Businesses are now encouraged to adopt cloud-based solutions, such as Windows Autopatch, Microsoft Intune, and Azure Update Manager, for keeping endpoints and servers on their network up to date.
"While the WSUS role remains available in Windows Server 2025, we recommend organizations transition to cloud tools, including including Windows Autopatch and Microsoft Intune for client update management and Azure Update Manager for server update management," Microsoft's Nir Froimovici said in September 2024. "Remember: WSUS remains operational but is no longer investing in new features."
Windows Server 2028 also removes VBScript (disabled by default in Internet Explorer 11 on Windows 10) and the legacy Windows Management Instrumentation Command-line (WMIC) utility (deprecated in Windows Server 2012 and Windows 10 21H1) to thwart a wide range of malware and attack tactics abusing them.
Windows Internet Name Service (WINS) support, deprecated with the release of Windows Server 2022 in August 2021, is also being removed in the next Windows Server version, as Microsoft announced a year ago.
Microsoft announced Windows Server 2028 last week at the Ignite 2026 conference, and it can be tested by registering for the Windows Insider Program for Windows Server or applying to enroll in the Windows Server Technology Adoption Program (TAP) for earlier access.

articles.title: Huawei’s Next Big AI Move: HBM Workaround
articles.text:
Huawei, while presenting its Ascend 960DT AI accelerator to prospective customers early this month, asked them to source their own high-bandwidth memory (HBM), which has become essential infrastructure for training and running large-scale AI models. Its supply is currently dominated by Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.
That’s because companies in China find it hard to secure HBM supply due to U.S. export controls, and industry watchers believe AI companies in China are now running low on their HBM stockpiles. An AI accelerator’s performance depends not only on the compute die but also on the capacity and bandwidth of the HBM beside it.
Ascend 960DT, due in early 2027, aims to compete with H100-class accelerators in AI servers. After the U.S. government restricted exports of Nvidia’s GPUs and other advanced AI processors to China, Huawei’s Ascend AI chips have become the most widely used AI accelerators in China. Huawei plans to release at least one new Ascend processor each year through 2029.
A few weeks after news surfaced that Huawei was asking Ascend 960DT customers to buy HBM themselves, Bloomberg reports that Huawei researchers have developed a new HBM with twice the data-pin density of memory devices currently mass-produced by Samsung and SK Hynix. Huawei will present more details about this custom HBM at ISSCC 2027, held on Feb. 14-18, 2027, in San Francisco.
The new HBM features a 64-channel, 4096-DQ data interface, and 5-layer wafer-on-wafer hybrid bonding, a 3D chip packaging technology that directly interconnects two full silicon wafers face-to-face without using any fillers between them. That, in turn, results in higher interconnect density, reduced power consumption and signal loss, and taller 3D die stacks.
In this custom HBM design, a five-layer direct-bond interconnection in HBM memory could refer to five stacked layers, with four DRAM layers connecting to the integrated memory controller via copper-to-copper or dielectric bonds. A paper scheduled for presentation at ISSCC 2027, titled “A 64-Channel 4096-DQ Custom HBM with Memory Controllers and 5-Layer Wafer-on-Wafer Hybrid Bonding,” describes how seven Huawei researchers based in Shenzhen plan to combine the memory controller with a multi-layer stacked memory design to build a customized memory framework.
Huawei has already used hybrid bonding in its Kirin mobile processors, which will launch later this year. In addition to hybrid bonding, Huawei’s HBM is also prioritizing thermal management and density optimization to address common bottlenecks in AI memory architecture.
ISSCC, an international conference hosted by the IEEE Solid-State Circuits Society and widely dubbed the Olympics of semiconductor design, requires designs implemented in actual silicon along with measurement results. However, it’s unclear how far Huawei has advanced in this HBM design undertaking amid massive design and manufacturing challenges.
No wonder memory industry experts in South Korea are watching this high-tech development closely. “Samsung Electronics is also developing various custom HBMs at a commercialization level with major U.S. big tech companies and applying hybrid bonding, and SK Hynix is doing the same,” said Choi Jae-hyuk, a professor in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at Seoul National University.
Kim Bong-jin, a professor in the School of Electrical Engineering at KAIST, acknowledged that HBM technology has advanced to the point where it’s difficult to distinguish the Samsung, SK Hynix, and CXMT papers. However, he noted that there is a difference between proving a technology in a paper and actually mass-producing a product.
In short, the key isn’t design metrics but mass production, and a considerable gap remains between proving a technology in a paper and supplying it reliably. So, while Huawei is seeking ways to break into the most lucrative AI hardware sector, it will most likely be an uphill battle for the Shenzhen, China-based tech behemoth to establish meaningful market share against entrenched competitors—Micron, Samsung, and SK Hynix—with decades of memory fabrication expertise.
At the same time, however, sanctions on China’s technology firms actually drove them to innovate more. Huawei teasing an HBM device illustrates this geopolitical irony; Huawei’s Ascend processors have become the most popular AI accelerators in China after U.S. restrictions on Nvidia’s most advanced GPUs.

articles.title: Dune 3 : le nouveau seau à popcorn vibrant qui ressemble à un sextoy fait rire tout le monde
articles.text:
À l’approche de la sortie en salles de Dune 3, prévue le 16 décembre 2026 en France (le 18 aux États-Unis), le film de Denis Villeneuve se fait presque voler la vedette par ses propres produits dérivés.
Il y a deux ans, pour Dune 2, la chaîne de cinémas américaine AMC avait déjà affolé les réseaux sociaux avec son seau à popcorn à l’effigie de Shai-Hulud. Son ouverture garnie de dents en silicone prêtait tellement le flanc aux blagues grivoises qu’elle avait inspiré un sketch du Saturday Night Live et fait rire Zendaya elle-même. Pour le dernier volet de la trilogie, AMC assume pleinement le sous-entendu.
Un double orifice « pour les couples » et un marteleur « fonctionnel » pour le seau de Dune 3
Cette semaine, une vidéo promotionnelle du circuit de cinémas malaisien GSC, vue plus de 5 millions de fois en quelques jours, a remis le feu aux poudres. On y voit une main plonger lentement dans la gueule d’un ver des sables, sous un éclairage tamisé. Les deux modèles les plus commentés en ligne viennent toutefois d’AMC, qui les a dévoilés le 29 octobre.
Le premier prend la forme d’un double ver des sables doté de deux ouvertures côte à côte, officiellement présenté par la chaîne comme un format idéal « pour les couples » souhaitant partager leur popcorn. Le second, avec un seul ver, intègre un petit marteleur (thumper) qu’AMC présente comme fonctionnel. Dans la vidéo de GSC, le seau vibre bien, même s’il y a un doute sur le fait que les modèles vendus en fassent autant.
Il n’en fallait pas plus pour que les internautes s’en donnent à cœur joie, comparant en masse ces accessoires de cinéma à des sextoys géants et saluant le sens de l’autodérision (ou l’inconscience totale) des équipes marketing de Dune 3.
Une guerre des produits dérivés face à Avengers : Doomsday
Derrière la blague se cache pourtant un véritable enjeu commercial pour les exploitants de salles. Depuis le seau R2-D2 de Star Wars : L’Ascension de Skywalker en 2019, et plus encore depuis celui de Dune 2, les seaux à popcorn collectors sont devenus une poule aux œufs d’or pour attirer les spectateurs en salle dès le premier jour. Les chaînes concurrentes rivalisent d’ailleurs d’imagination, entre le seau inspiré du vaisseau du Navigateur de la Guilde chez Regal et la version cuivrée chez Cinemark, sans oublier les gobelets, plaids et peluches à l’effigie des vers géants.
Vendus à partir du 17 décembre chez AMC aux États-Unis, et proposés en Europe dans les cinémas Odeon, ces objets collectors risquent une nouvelle fois de s’arracher à prix d’or à la revente. D’autant que Dune : Troisième partie sortira le même jour qu’Avengers : Doomsday, donnant lieu à une bataille sans merci jusque sur les comptoirs à friandises, où les vers vibrants d’Arrakis affronteront les seaux à l’effigie du Docteur Fatalis.

articles.title: PCB Grounding Design and Return Path
articles.text:
Many PCB design guidelines reduce grounding to a few rules:
- Separate analog and digital ground
- Connect power ground and signal ground at a single point
- Cut out copper under switching nodes
These rules are not wrong, but they are incomplete. They do not answer a fundamental question: where does the current return?
If a ground plane is split and a signal crosses the gap, its return current may be forced to detour. The result can be higher electromagnetic radiation, even though the original intention was noise isolation. This article follows one main principle: design “ground” as a return path.
Why Ground Moves
Every copper trace, via, and ground plane has impedance.
At DC, copper resistance causes a voltage drop. When current changes rapidly, parasitic inductance also produces a voltage.
If a sensitive measurement branch shares part of its return path with a high-current branch, the voltage drop across that shared copper appears in the measurement branch.
The “ground” may then move with the high-current load. This is common-impedance coupling.
As shown above, loads farther along a shared return copper path use more common copper segments and may see larger ground-potential shifts. In a real PCB, current distribution and impedance vary with frequency, copper shape, and via structure; a single DC resistance cannot represent the return path. The first step in grounding analysis is therefore to identify which currents share a return path and whether that shared path lies directly under a sensitive circuit reference.
Single-Point vs. Multi-Point Grounding
Single-point grounding has two common forms.
In series single-point grounding (also called daisy-chain grounding), branches are connected one after another to a common ground line. This is simple to route, but ground-potential differences can build up along the line, as shown in Figure 1.
In parallel single-point grounding (also called star grounding), shared impedance is reduced. At high frequencies, however, the parasitic inductance of long ground traces can divert high-frequency return current to other low-impedance paths.
As frequency rises, the parasitic inductance of a long trace to the star point may make high-frequency return current prefer a nearby reference plane or a decoupling capacitor. High-frequency layouts should therefore focus on short local loops and continuous reference planes.
Decoupling capacitors should connect directly to a complete ground plane, implementing multi-point grounding.
In summary, single-point grounding is mainly used at low frequency to reduce common-impedance coupling, while multi-point grounding is mainly used at high frequency to lower return-path impedance and parasitic inductance. In practice, the two must be considered together according to operating frequency and return path. A single grounding style should not be applied mechanically.
Why Blind Ground-Plane Splitting Can Be Worse
When a signal trace runs over a continuous ground plane, high-frequency return current concentrates directly beneath the trace, forming a closed loop. Once the plane is split, return current for a signal crossing the gap must detour. This increases loop area and parasitic inductance, raises magnetic-field energy storage, and sharply increases crosstalk and EMI risk. More seriously, redirected return current may couple through parasitic capacitance to other planes and generate a common-mode voltage, which can drive cables to radiate.
Therefore, ground-plane splitting is not equivalent to noise isolation. Incorrect splitting can destroy a low-impedance return path and make EMI and signal-integrity problems worse.
Mixed-Signal Grounding: Partition, Route, and Review Return
Planning the positions of analog, digital, and switching-power circuits by function is a useful layout approach. However, functional partitioning does not mean cutting the ground plane. A more robust sequence is:
1. Partition first.Group sensitive circuits such as ADCs and analog sampling, and keep digital logic, clocks, and high-speed interfaces relatively independent. This determines what is placed next to what.
2. Route second. Minimize high-frequency local current loops. Use Kelvin connections for current sensing, route differential pairs in parallel, and place decoupling capacitors close to pins. This keeps current paths short.
3. Review the return path. Check whether the reference plane under each cross-region signal is continuous and whether decoupling capacitors provide a nearby return path. This confirms where the return current flows.
Mixed-signal grounding should follow “functional partition first, routing control second, return-path review last,” rather than relying on ground-plane cuts for noise isolation.

- Higher Current Discharge: Reverse boost supports VBUS up to 24V and 12A output, compliant with PD PPS and Qi 2.2 MPP TX.

- Wider Switching Frequency: Switching Frequency: 200kHz – 600kHz.

Applications

- Wireless charging transmitters (Qi 2.2 MPP Tx)
Taking the PCB design recommendations for the NU6810 as an example,the following five checks put the preceding principles into practice.
NU6810 Layout Recommendations
The figure above shows a NU6810 PCB return-path design that applies nearly every grounding principle discussed above. The design can be translated into five executable layout checks.
1. Use a complete, continuous GND plane. A dedicated GND plane on layer 2 is recommended. The IC’s central PGND,the power ground, and the ground terminals of the decoupling capacitors should connect directly to this plane through nearby vias. Deliberately splitting analog ground and power ground is not recommended.
2. Keep sensitive signals away from switching nodes. VBUS/VBAT_SNS, IBUS/IBAT_SNSP/N, COMP, and similar signals should be kept away from SW nodes and the inductor. Current sensing must use Kelvin connections, with differential traces routed in parallel and a continuous reference ground.
3. Control noise through partitioning, not plane cutting. The core principle is: complete continuous GND plane + nearby multi-point grounding + appropriate decoupling + minimized high-frequency power loop + sensitive signals kept away from SW nodes.
4. Do not open a window under SW1/SW2. SW1 and SW2 are high-dv/dt switching nodes. Reducing parasitic capacitance and noise coupling to nearby sensitive signals requires two conditions to be met simultaneously. From an EMI perspective, copper area should be reasonably controlled because it determines parasitic capacitance and noise coupling. From a thermal perspective, SW1, SW2, VBUS, and VBAT are important heat-dissipation paths, so copper should not be excessively reduced; local solder-mask openings and solder addition may be used when necessary. In addition, the layer-2 GND plane beneath SW1 and SW2 should be retained. This helps provide a complete high-frequency return path for surrounding signals and avoids return-current detours, increased loop area, and EMI degradation caused by plane openings.
5. Place decoupling capacitors close to the IC. C_BUS and C_BAT should be placed as close as possible to the power pins and PGND of the IC, using short and wide copper connections.
High-Frequency Decoupling and MLCC Selection
MLCCs have parasitic inductance (ESL). Above the self-resonant frequency, impedance rises with frequency. As shown in Figure 9, at 100 MHz a 10 µF/0603 capacitor has an impedance of about 0.2 Ω, whereas a 10 nF/0201 capacitor has only about 0.06 Ω. Therefore, low-ESL, small-size high-frequency capacitors should be placed closest to the IC pins. When debugging EMI in the 100–300 MHz range, capacitors with low impedance and high self-resonant frequency should be selected to improve high-frequency decoupling.
The core principle remains: a complete continuous GND plane + nearby multi-point grounding + appropriate decoupling selection + a minimized high-frequency power loop + sensitive signals kept away from switching nodes.
Four Self-Check Questions
These four questions can be used directly in a design-review checklist:
1. Where does the current return? Draw the closed path.
2. Which currents share a return path? Does high current flow through a sensitive reference point?
3. Is the reference plane continuous? Are there any gaps or openings?
4. Is there evidence that the change worked? Verify with waveforms and EMI tests.
For the complete NU681X PCB reference design or to request an EVM evaluation board, contact the NuVolta technical team at sales@nuvoltatech.com.
NuVolta Technologies, founded in 2017, focuses on power-management ICs and solutions, including wireless charging receiver and transmitter ICs, wired fast-charging ICs, general analog power devices, and automotive power-management ICs for consumer electronics, automotive electronics, industrial, and medical applications.

articles.title: AI discovers a hidden heart signal that could predict sudden death
articles.text:
AI discovers a hidden heart signal that could predict sudden death
- Date:
  November 14, 2026
- Source:
  University of California - Berkeley
- Summary:
  Scientists have uncovered a hidden warning sign in routine heart scans that could predict sudden cardiac death before it strikes. The AI-powered discovery outperformed conventional screening methods, potentially revealing thousands of people at risk of a fatal heart malfunction that doctors might otherwise miss.
- Share:
More than 300,000 people in the United States die from sudden cardiac arrest each year. This deadly emergency occurs when the heart's electrical system suddenly fails, causing the heart to stop pumping blood. It can strike older adults with known heart conditions as well as seemingly healthy young athletes. Although implanted defibrillators can prevent some of these deaths, doctors have long struggled to determine which patients need them most.
Now, researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a previously overlooked warning signal in routine heart scans that could make it easier to recognize people at risk before a fatal event occurs.
The discovery was made using artificial intelligence trained on more than 440,000 electrocardiograms, or EKGs, collected in Sweden. By comparing the electrical patterns recorded in these scans with information from death certificates, the researchers taught an AI system to recognize subtle differences between healthy individuals, patients with known heart risks, and people who eventually died from sudden cardiac causes.
The team then evaluated the technology using thousands of additional patient records from the United States and Taiwan, testing whether the patterns could reliably identify people at heightened risk in different populations.
AI Detects Hidden Heart Risks That Standard Tests Miss
The results suggest that AI can identify vulnerable patients more effectively than the conventional tests doctors typically rely on. Current screening methods largely focus on how much blood the heart pumps with each contraction, a measurement used to assess whether someone might benefit from an implanted defibrillator.
Using these traditional measurements, doctors can identify a group of patients with an annual sudden cardiac death rate of 4.6%. The AI system, however, identified a group with an annual death rate of 7%, demonstrating a greater ability to distinguish patients facing serious danger.
Importantly, the algorithm also recognized a broader population of people at elevated risk, including thousands who would not normally raise concerns under existing medical guidelines. Most of these individuals would have been classified as relatively low risk using conventional methods.
Another major advantage is that the AI system works with ordinary EKG images, which are already routinely collected in hospitals and medical centers around the world. This means the technology could potentially improve screening without requiring an entirely new type of medical test.
The findings, published in Nature, could eventually help physicians make more informed decisions about who should receive an implanted defibrillator. They also raise an intriguing scientific question about what changes inside the heart produce the electrical patterns that AI has learned to recognize.
"Medical decisions are really hard, and I think that's why AI is so exciting for me," said Ziad Obermeyer, an associate professor at UC Berkeley's School of Public Health and the study's lead author. "We can not only make better decisions, but also start to understand what's actually going on with these patients before their heart stops."
Why Sudden Cardiac Death Is So Difficult to Predict
Sudden cardiac arrest is different from a heart attack. A heart attack happens when blood flow to part of the heart becomes blocked or severely restricted. Cardiac arrest, by contrast, results from a failure of the electrical signals that coordinate the heartbeat.
Immediate CPR and an electrical shock from an automated external defibrillator can sometimes restore the heart's rhythm. However, roughly 90% of people who experience sudden cardiac arrest outside a hospital die within minutes, making early recognition of those at risk especially important.
For Obermeyer, an emergency physician whose research combines artificial intelligence, medicine, and health policy, sudden cardiac death remains one of medicine's most frustrating unsolved problems.
Because victims often die without warning, researchers have limited opportunities to observe what happens inside the heart immediately before it stops. An autopsy may uncover blocked blood vessels, hardened tissue, or other structural abnormalities, but it cannot fully reveal how the heart was functioning in the moments leading up to death.
"One thing that makes the problem very tragic, but also very well suited for AI, is that we have the cure for this problem," Obermeyer said. "If you knew you were one of the people who was going to drop dead, you would go to a cardiologist and you'd get a defibrillator implanted. The problem is that doctors can't figure out who needs one before it's too late."
The Problem With Current Heart Risk Screening
Doctors currently rely heavily on a measurement of how effectively the heart pushes blood out with each beat. Patients whose hearts pump below a specified threshold may be considered candidates for an implantable cardioverter defibrillator, a device that can deliver an electrical shock when a dangerous heart rhythm develops.
But obtaining this measurement generally requires a more extensive medical evaluation. Many people who eventually experience sudden cardiac arrest never receive such testing because they have no obvious reason to suspect they are in danger.
The approach also has limitations for patients who are identified as high risk. About two-thirds of implanted defibrillators in these patients never need to deliver a shock. As a result, many individuals undergo expensive, invasive procedures for potentially fatal emergencies that may never occur.
At the same time, thousands of people who are not recognized as being at risk die unexpectedly each year.
"In some fraction of those people, we could have prevented those deaths if we had just known it in time," Obermeyer said. "There are a lot of lives being lost from people who are dropping dead of sudden cardiac death that are preventable if we just had better AI tools to find these things."
The researchers hope that identifying more accurate warning signs could help doctors direct preventive treatments toward the patients most likely to benefit.
How Researchers Trained AI to Recognize Deadly Heart Patterns
Developing the algorithm required three independent collections of medical data gathered from different parts of the world.
The researchers began with six years of EKG recordings from Sweden's unified healthcare system. By linking these scans to death certificates, they could examine the electrical patterns of patients who later experienced sudden cardiac death and compare them with those of other patients.
The AI learned to identify combinations of spikes, waves, and other characteristics in the recordings that appeared to be associated with increased risk. Once the system had been trained, the team tested it against two additional datasets: two years of anonymized EKG records from a San Diego hospital system and a separate collection of patient data from Taipei.
This international testing helped researchers evaluate whether the algorithm's predictive abilities extended beyond the Swedish population used to develop it.
"Good AI starts with good data," said Obermeyer, who is also part of the joint UCSF-UC Berkeley Computational Precision Health program. "Unfortunately, data like the ones we used for this study are incredibly hard to access. It's a big part of why there's so little clinical AI in use today."
Obtaining and organizing the information was itself a massive undertaking. According to Obermeyer, assembling the datasets took approximately 10 years and involved contributions from two organizations he helped establish, Dandelion Health and Nightingale Open Science. Both organizations work to advance medical research through better access to data and artificial intelligence.
"It's one of the tremendous luxuries of being at Berkeley," Obermeyer said. "You can pursue these projects that just are a slow burn and then have -- hopefully -- a big return when they get over the finish line."
From Hidden Heart Signals to Lifesaving Treatments
The researchers have already begun exploring how the system might be used in actual healthcare settings.
Obermeyer is collaborating with medical systems in Sweden, Taiwan, and the United States to introduce the algorithm into hospital EKG databases. The goal is to examine existing heart scans for signs of elevated risk and identify patients who may benefit from additional monitoring.
Under the proposed approach, physicians would contact patients whose EKGs receive a high-risk assessment and offer them the opportunity to wear a patch that continuously records their heart's electrical activity.
These longer recordings could provide valuable clues about the biological processes responsible for the warning signals detected by the AI. Understanding those processes could help researchers explain why certain hearts are more vulnerable to suddenly developing fatal electrical disturbances.
For some patients, the additional information might ultimately support a recommendation to receive an implanted defibrillator, potentially preventing a sudden and otherwise unexpected death.
Obermeyer has also created a website where people interested in learning about their own risk can provide basic personal information and an email address. The research team can then contact them about EKG analysis when the technology becomes more widely available.
Could AI Reveal New Secrets About the Human Heart?
Beyond its potential to improve the prevention of sudden cardiac death, the discovery highlights how artificial intelligence could help scientists investigate medical mysteries that have resisted conventional approaches.
Rather than simply identifying patients who might need treatment, the algorithm has uncovered patterns in heart activity that researchers do not yet fully understand. Studying those signals could lead to new insights into the electrical disturbances responsible for sudden cardiac death and potentially reveal additional opportunities for prevention.
Obermeyer believes this ability to uncover previously unrecognized biological patterns could become one of AI's most important contributions to medicine, opening new directions for research while helping physicians make better decisions.
"There is also going to be a new way of doing science that comes out of these tools," Obermeyer said, "and it's fun to think about how that starts happening."

articles.title: Windows 11 : le masquage automatique de la barre des tâches à gauche et à droite « arrive bientôt »
articles.text:
Il y a quelques mois, Microsoft exauçait le vœu le plus cher de millions d’utilisateurs au sein de Windows 11 : la possibilité de déplacer la barre des tâches. Cette option, déployée à grande échelle avec la mise à jour de sécurité du mois de septembre, a toutefois été accueillie avec quelques réserves.
Car si les utilisateurs ont salué l’arrivée de cette barre des tâches amovible, ils ont aussi reproché à Microsoft d’avoir oublié d’y intégrer certaines fonctionnalités. Microsoft a par exemple omis la possibilité de repositionner celle-ci à l’aide d’un simple glisser-déposer. La firme de Redmond a d’ailleurs été très claire à ce sujet : Windows 11 ne l’autorisera jamais.
L’entreprise a également oublié d’intégrer la possibilité de masquer automatiquement la barre des tâches lorsque celle-ci est positionnée ailleurs qu’en bas de l’écran. Cette absence pourrait néanmoins être très rapidement corrigée.
Le masquage automatique à gauche et à droite « arrive bientôt »
Jusqu’à présent, lorsque vous vous rendez dans le menu Paramètres > Personnalisation > Barre des tâches, l’option qui permet de Masquer automatiquement la barre des tâches ne s’applique que lorsque celle-ci est positionnée en bas de l’écran. Microsoft l’affiche d’ailleurs très clairement dans une petite alerte affichée en dessous de l’option. Mais les choses seraient visiblement sur le point d’évoluer.
Sur X / Twitter, en réponse à un tweet évoquant une nouvelle option pour afficher les fenêtres d’applications ouvertes dans une liste depuis la barre des tâches, un utilisateur a profité de l’occasion pour réclamer une option permettant de masquer automatiquement la barre des tâches lorsque celle-ci était positionnée à gauche ou à droite de l’écran.
 Coming soon!
— Tali Roth 🪟 (@TeaAndDates) November 24, 2026
La réponse n’a pas tardé à venir puisque Tali Roth, responsable produit chez Microsoft a répondu à sa missive en indiquant que la fonction « arrivait bientôt ». La fonction est donc à présent confirmée, mais aucune date de disponibilité ou de déploiement n’est pour l’instant connue. Il faudra sans doute patienter encore quelques semaines pour que celle-ci soit soumise aux tests des Insiders, avant d’arriver officiellement dans la version stable de Windows 11 au cours d’une prochaine mise à jour.

articles.title: Après l’hybride, le Zeekr 8X électrique lâche 925 ch pour défier le Range Rover
articles.text:
Comme souvent avec les voitures présentées en Chine, c’est le dossier d’homologation déposé auprès du MIIT, le ministère chinois de l’Industrie et des Technologies de l’information, et rendu public ce mercredi 25 novembre, qui nous apprend l’existence d’une nouvelle voiture ou, dans le cas qui nous intéresse aujourd’hui, d’une nouvelle version électrique après la déclinaison hybride que nous avons pu découvrir il y a quelques mois en Chine.
Lancé en Chine le 17 avril, le 8X hybride rechargeable y est vendu entre 356 800 et 500 800 yuans (environ 49 000 à 68 000 euros). Il a déjà été livré à 31 221 exemplaires fin octobre, soit près de 10 % des livraisons de Zeekr sur les dix premiers mois de l’année.
Le Zeekr 8X mesure 5,10 mètres de long pour 2,00 mètres de large et 1,78 mètre de haut, avec un empattement de 3,07 mètres. Autant dire qu’il joue dans la catégorie des très grands SUV, celle où l’on trouve déjà le Mercedes GLS ou le Range Rover.
L’habitacle sera proposé en 5 ou 6 places. Côté poids, les chiffres sont sans surprise : entre 2,76 et 2,92 tonnes à vide, selon la version. Un poids considérable, qui pèsera forcément sur les consommations et sur le comportement dynamique.
Votre production solaire dépasse votre consommation ? Stockez le surplus au lieu de le revendre à bas prix. Le SolarFlow 2400 AC+ se branche sur votre installation existante, 100 % plug-and-play, et s’amortit plus vite grâce au Black Friday.
Une puissance, comme souvent, démesurée
Sur le papier, la puissance reste en retrait par rapport aux quelque 1 400 ch (1 030 kW) de la version hybride à trois moteurs. Cette version électrique embarque deux moteurs, un par essieu, de 310 et 370 kW, soit environ 421 ch et 503 ch, pour 680 kW cumulés, environ 925 ch.
La vitesse maximale annoncée atteint 260 km/h. Dans la pratique, ces valeurs servent surtout à alimenter la course aux fiches techniques que se livrent les constructeurs chinois, et leur intérêt au quotidien reste limité, surtout sur un véhicule de près de 3 tonnes.
Les batteries NMC seront fournies par CATL-Geely Power Battery. Le document ne mentionne pas leur capacité. Les versions hybrides actuelles embarquent déjà 55 ou 70 kWh, et le Zeekr 7X, plus petit, propose en Chine une batterie de 103 kWh : il est donc probable que la version électrique dépasse les 100 kWh. De quoi imaginer une autonomie d’au moins 800 km selon le cycle CLTC chinois, nettement plus avantageux que notre cycle WLTP européen.
Zeekr avait d’ailleurs préparé le terrain. En avril, au salon de Pékin, Kennet Pettersson, ingénieur en chef de Zeekr Europe chargé de l’architecture mécanique, expliquait que la conversion pourrait aller vite : le 8X et le 9X ont été conçus dès le départ comme des électriques, avant qu’on leur ajoute un moteur thermique. Il suffit donc de retirer ce dernier et le réservoir pour loger une batterie plus grosse.
Rien à envier à Mercedes ou Porsche ?
Ce concurrent des Mercedes GLS, Range Rover électrique et autres Porsche Cayenne électrique a des arguments, et non des moindres. Le dossier liste notamment, parfois en option, des marchepieds électriques, des barres de toit et des aides à la conduite avancées, avec un LiDAR sur le toit, des LiDAR d’angle mort à l’avant et à l’arrière et une caméra trifocale. Avec l’attelage proposé en option, le SUV pourra tracter jusqu’à 2 tonnes.
En Chine, le lancement est attendu dans les prochains mois. Pour l’Europe, en revanche, Zeekr n’a encore communiqué ni calendrier ni tarif pour cette version, alors que les droits de douane supplémentaires sur les électriques chinoises compliquent le jeu. Une arrivée chez nous reste toutefois probable, puisque Zeekr, qui propose déjà une gamme de véhicules en France, y commercialise le modèle encore plus grand, le 9X, ainsi que son petit frère, le 7X.
Gageons qu’il sera moins cher que le 9X, vendu à partir de 119 500 euros chez nous, mais uniquement en version « Super Hybrid », c’est-à-dire en hybride rechargeable de 897 ch.
Pour se faire une idée de l’écart de prix, le 9X Ultra, vendu 485 900 yuans en Chine (environ 66 000 euros), est facturé 119 500 euros en France et en Allemagne, presque le double. Fabriqué en Chine, il n’ouvre droit ni au bonus écologique ni à la prime à la conversion, comme le reste de la gamme Zeekr, et rien n’indique qu’un 8X électrique produit au même endroit ferait exception.

articles.title: Diese Seevögel hören Schiffe, die nicht gefunden werden wollen
articles.text:
Illegale Fischerei: Wie Basstölpel mit Mikrofonen „unsichtbare“ Schiffe aufspüren
Wer wissen will, wo Fischtrawler und Frachter unterwegs sind, schaut auf AIS‑Daten. Das Automatic Identification System ist ein Funksystem, über das Schiffe ihre Position öffentlich senden.
Viele Schiffe tauchen in diesen Daten allerdings nie auf. Weltweit gelten drei Viertel der industriellen Fischereischiffe und 30 Prozent aller Transportschiffe als nicht von AIS erfasst. Unter anderem, um illegale Fischerei zu verschleiern. Jonathan Rutter von der University of Oxford und Kollegen haben nun gezeigt, dass Seevögel mithelfen könnten, solche illegalen Aktivitäten aufzuspüren.
Warum Fischkutter gefährlich für Seevögel sind
Rutter und seine Kollegen statteten Seevögel (Nordkormoran, Westlandsturmvogel und Balearen-Sturmtaucher, die jeweils in einem unterschiedlichen Meereslebensraum leben) mit Audio-Rekordern und GPS-Empfängern aus. Alle drei Arten ernähren sich regelmäßig von Fischereiabfällen – unerwünschten Teilen des Fangs, die die Besatzung wieder über Bord wirft. Außerdem versuchen sie, Köder von Langleinen zu ergattern. Das ist allerdings für die Vögel ziemlich gefährlich.
Die Vögel verfangen sich in Netzen oder schlucken beköderte Haken und sterben dabei. Beim Balearen-Sturmtaucher ist der Beifang, vor allem in der handwerklichen spanischen Langleinenfischerei, laut dem Paper so hoch, dass der Art innerhalb von Jahrzehnten das Aussterben droht. Weil andererseits bekannt ist, dass ein großer Teil der Fischerei-Aktivitäten nicht durch AIS-Daten erfasst wird, wollten die Forschenden mithilfe der Audio-Rekorder herausfinden, wie viel Zeit die Vögel tatsächlich in der Nähe von Fischkuttern verbringen.
Wie Audio-Rekorder illegalen Fischfang aufspüren
Die Forschenden rüsteten insgesamt 20 Vögel mit leichten Audio-Rekordern und GPS-Empfängern aus, die sie mit Klebeband auf dem Rücken der Vögel befestigten. Sie nutzten handelsübliche Audio-Rekorder von Open Acoustic Devices, die in diversen Bioakustik-Projekten zum Einsatz kommen. Obwohl diese Rekorder nur sehr wenig Energie brauchen, mussten die Forschenden größere Batterien einbauen – auf der anderen Seite sollte das Gewicht der Rekorder nicht zu groß werden. Zwölf der Aufzeichnungen konnten die Forschenden anschließend auswerten. Wie die Geräte nach dem Einsatz von den Vögeln geborgen wurden, beschreibt auch das Paper nicht.
Die akustischen Daten analysierten Rutter und seine Kollegen anschließend mit einer speziellen Software. Sie sucht im Bereich von 30 bis 1000 Hertz nach Amplitudenspitzen, die sich vom Hintergrundrauschen abheben. Denn Schiffe hinterlassen im Spektrogramm, also der grafischen Darstellung von Frequenzen über die Zeit, eine typische Spur. Während Motor, Auspuff, und Propeller tieffrequente Töne erzeugen, sorgt das Platzen winziger Dampfblasen am Propeller, auch für hochfrequente Komponenten.
Wie viel nicht registrierte Fischerei entdeckt wurde
Die Forschenden stellten fest, dass ein beträchtlicher Prozentsatz der dokumentierten Geräusche von Schiffen sich nicht mit den von AIS gemeldeten Aktivitäten überschnitt. So verbrachten Basstölpel beispielsweise durchschnittlich 68 Minuten pro Tag in der Nähe von Schiffen – und mindestens 22 Minuten davon in der Nähe von Schiffen, die nicht erfasst wurden. Mit anderen Worten: Mindestens 32 Prozent der von den Basstölpeln aufgezeichneten Schiffsgeräusche stammten von Schiffen, die im AIS nicht erfasst waren. Die Forschenden gehen aber davon aus, dass die Messwerte nur die untere Grenze markieren und es eher für 50 Prozent aller Schiffe, denen die Vögel begegnen, kein AIS-Signal gibt.
Das muss nicht unbedingt heißen, dass die Fischerboote illegal unterwegs waren. In spanischen Gewässern beispielsweise sind viele kleine Fischerboote unterwegs, die nicht verpflichtet sind, AIS-Signale zu senden. Allerdings tragen auch diese Boote dazu bei, durch Beifang den Bestand der Seevögel zu gefährden, schreiben die Forschenden.
Wie eine Echtzeit-Überwachung möglich wäre
„Die Audioerkennung könnte besonders nützlich sein, um die Bewertung von Beifang- und Kollisionsrisiken zu verbessern, bei denen eine Verzerrung durch Kleinfischerei, schlechten AIS-Empfang oder die Deaktivierung des AIS vermutet wird“, schreiben sie in ihrem Paper weiter.
Bisher speichern die Rekorder die Tonaufnahmen. Die Forschenden müssen die Geräte wieder einsammeln und die Aufnahmen später am Computer auswerten. Künftig könnte der Algorithmus direkt im Gerät am Tier laufen. Das Gerät würde nicht die Audiodaten übertragen, sondern nur noch die Ergebnisse, also ob und wann ein Schiff zu hören war. Diese wenigen Daten ließen sie sich per Satellit oder Mobilfunk verschicken. Damit wäre eine Erkennung von Schiffen in Echtzeit möglich, schreiben sie.
Vor einem Einsatz von Seevögeln als eine Art Fischerei-Patrouille, wie es 2020 mit Albatrossen gezeigt wurde, warnen sie allerdings, „damit Fischer nicht das Vertrauen in Wissenschaftler und/oder in die Meerestiere selbst verlieren.“

articles.title: Drupal warns of new site takeover flaw exploited in attacks
articles.text:
The Drupal security team says attackers are exploiting a second critical vulnerability that lets them breach and hijack unpatched websites.
Last week, Drupal patched a remote code execution (RCE) flaw (tracked as CVE-2026-132165 / Fail2Install) that lets anonymous users take over vulnerable sites by abusing the Drupal installer.
While the security issue wasn't initially flagged as being abused in the wild, an update to the original security advisory warned that threat actors began exploiting it one day after patches were released.
The new security issue (CVE-2026-136716), patched one week later, addresses attack vectors that were left unpatched and also lets attackers hijack vulnerable Drupal sites.
"However, certain sites in unusual or incomplete install states remain vulnerable to site takeover following that advisory, including production sites. It is not apparent in the user interface if a site is in the affected vulnerable state, and sites that are already compromised may no longer be in the vulnerable state," Drupal said on Wednesday.
"This is being exploited in the wild. Any site that left its installer remotely accessible following SA-CORE-2026-017 may still have been compromised."
While it has yet to share further details regarding these attacks, Drupal warned users that any unsecured website may have been compromised and advised admins to ensure the user 1 email address is one they control, and to consider resetting it.
They should also check site logs for unauthorized access, focusing on unexpected changes to or by the user 1 account, and follow this guide if they find evidence the site may have been compromised.
Those who can't immediately upgrade to Drupal 10.6.23, 11.3.23, or 11.4.14 should secure the installer on all new and existing sites by blocking access to /core/install.php in the web server configuration or the .htaccess file in the web root.
The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has flagged six Drupal security flaws as being abused in the wild since November 2021, two of which have also been exploited in ransomware attacks.

articles.title: Consiguen ejecutar GTA 6 en Mac, pero hay un detalle que cambia todo
articles.text:
Grand Theft Auto 6 no tendrá una versión para Mac, pero eso no significa que los usuarios de Apple se vayan a quedar sin probarlo. Algunos desarrolladores están desarrollando ports para macOS basándose en la versión filtrada del juego para Xbox Series X|S. El desarrollo todavía se encuentra en una fase muy temprana, aunque ya es posible ejecutar GTA 6 en una Mac.
De acuerdo con MacRumors, varios proyectos de la comunidad han logrado correr GTA 6 de forma nativa en Macs con Apple Silicon. El resultado está lejos de ofrecer la experiencia que vemos en PS5 o Xbox, ya que el juego apenas alcanza los 3 fotogramas por segundo y está cargado de errores visuales. No obstante, una de las partes más difíciles se ha conseguido y solo queda ver si Rockstar Games y Take-Two no tomarán represalias.
Actualmente existen dos proyectos que intentan llevar GTA 6 a Mac. El más conocido es VIctory-macOS, que se basa en el trabajo realizado por VIctory para ejecutar la versión de Xbox Series X|S en Mac mediante Wine, Rosetta 2 y D3D Metal. Según el repositorio de GitHub, la versión actual todavía no es jugable, pero los desarrolladores han conseguido iniciar el juego, mostrar menús y pantallas de carga y acceder a algunas partes del mapa en equipos con chips M2 Pro, M3 Max y M5 Pro.
La última actualización afirma que el rendimiento ha mejorado notablemente durante la carga, pasando de 8 fps a 26 o 30 fps en ciertos escenarios. Los desarrolladores mencionan que el principal cuello de botella es el rendimiento dentro del juego, que suele moverse a un fotograma cada dos segundos.
GTA 6 está todavía lejos de tener una versión jugable en Mac
El segundo proyecto es Halfwave: VIctory, otra bifurcación que añade optimizaciones para el Apple Silicon y que combina mejoras de distintos forks del original. En esta versión, los desarrolladores lograron ejecutar el juego, aunque corre a 3-5 fotogramas por segundo en un MacBook Pro con M4 Pro con 48 GB de memoria.
El repositorio de GitHub menciona que la actualización más reciente permite controlar a Jason. Las partidas guardadas funcionan y pueden cargarse correctamente. También se renderizan elementos como la iluminación solar, sombras, personajes, ropa y reflejos en agua y superficies metálicas. Una prueba en la primera misión del bote alcanzó los 6 fps a una resolución 1080p.
Al igual que VIctory-macOS, Halfwave no es jugable a velocidad normal y todavía existen muchos glitches en la parte visual. Por ejemplo, algunos objetos parpadean en negro, el raytracing está deshabilitado para ciertos reflejos y la iluminación nocturna todavía no coincide con lo que vemos en consola.
GTA 6 fue desarrollado para una arquitectura distinta a la de los Mac, por lo que necesita varias capas de traducción para poder ejecutarse. En los ports basados en VIctory, Rosetta 2 convierte las instrucciones del juego para que puedan ser interpretadas por los chips de Apple, mientras que CrossOver y Wine permiten correr componentes pensados para Windows. Al mismo tiempo, D3DMetal traduce las instrucciones gráficas de DirectX 12 al lenguaje Metal que utilizan las GPU de los Mac.
Es difícil saber si estas versiones conseguirán su objetivo. Take-Two ya comenzó con la cacería y hace unos días eliminó más de 3.000 repositorios. La casa matriz de Rockstar Games no descansará hasta acabar con cualquier intento no autorizado de lanzar GTA 6 en otras plataformas.

articles.title: AWS Nitro Sandboxes give AI agents a place to run
articles.text:
AWS Nitro Sandboxes give AI agents a place to run
A coding agent has written a script and wants to run it. The script may do exactly what the developer asked. The next decision, though, belongs to humans.
The team building the system has to answer a slew of questions: Where should that code run? What should it be able to reach once it starts?
The script doesn’t get a vote.
At the recent KubeCon + CloudNativeCon conference in Salt Lake City, The New Stack’s Frederic Lardinois asked AWS Senior Product Manager Mike Stefaniak what’s keeping more teams from running agents in production.
Stefaniak said he’s seen a handful of large customers commit in a big way. Many others are still figuring out security and identity. AWS Nitro Sandboxes, announced at the conference, address one part of that problem by giving developers an isolated place to run container workloads.
Keep the image, change where it runs
Stefaniak describes Nitro Sandboxes as a way to bring the isolation of the Nitro hypervisor to multiple workloads within one EC2 instance. Each sandbox draws CPU and memory from the parent instance.
“You don’t have to change your container image.”
On EKS Auto Mode or ECS Managed Instances, Stefaniak says, a runtime configuration tells AWS to place the workload in a sandbox.
“You don’t have to change your container image.”
That’s important to a developer with an existing build pipeline who wants to change how a workload runs without rebuilding the application around a new packaging model. Teams operating standard EC2 instances can also use the sandboxes, Stefaniak says, with more setup to wire up the runtime.
The use case extends beyond agents. A SaaS provider might otherwise put customers on separate nodes or clusters to isolate their workloads. Stefaniak sees an opportunity to run multiple tenants on the same node while keeping their workloads isolated. That could mean fewer clusters to look after, a benefit that anyone who has spent an afternoon coordinating upgrades can appreciate.
Decide what can leave the sandbox
Stefaniak distinguishes between isolated and confidential modes. In confidential mode, he says, the parent instance can’t inspect what’s inside the sandbox. Attestation also opens up a distribution option for a software vendor or model provider. It can ship encrypted code or model artifacts to a customer and use policy to control where they can be decrypted and run.
“Isolation is one piece of the puzzle when it comes to running agents.”
A workload with no need for network access can run in a confidential sandbox configured without a network interface. An agent that needs to call a model or query a service raises a different set of questions.
“Isolation is one piece of the puzzle when it comes to running agents,” Stefaniak said.
Stefaniak identifies workload identity and egress controls as two other pieces. Teams need to decide what identity an agent uses and which destinations it can reach. He describes customers who want model calls to go through an approved gateway, where they can apply governance policies and track spending. AWS is exploring how to enforce that path, including a possible role for Envoy.
“I think the tipping point is close.”
The interview also gets into what AWS contributed to Linux and containerd and why the company wants Nitro Sandboxes to work with emerging open source orchestration projects.
Stefaniak says the integration with Agent Sandbox is already working and describes the Agent Substrate work as an early proof of concept. “I think the tipping point is close,” Stefaniak said.
Watch the full interview on The New Stack’s YouTube channel for Stefaniak’s take on what would make teams comfortable moving agents into production, how SaaS developers might use the same isolation, and why some of the hardest work starts when an agent needs to reach outside its sandbox.

articles.title: Tablet da Samsung despenca para R$ 4.299 e chega com S Pen inclusa
articles.text:
O Samsung Galaxy Tab S10+ na versão de 12,4″, 256 GB e 12 GB de RAM apareceu com um dos cortes mais expressivos da Black Friday 2026: sai de R$ 8.999 por R$ 4.299 — redução de mais de R$ 4.700 e desconto de 52%. É um dos tablets Android mais robustos do mercado, com tela AMOLED Dinâmica 2X, caneta S Pen e Capa Teclado com tecla AI inclusas na caixa. Em outras palavras, chega pronto para substituir um notebook em cenários como edição de documentos, anotações, desenho digital, videoconferência e consumo de mídia em tela grande.
Samsung Galaxy Tab S10+ — 256 GB, 12 GB RAM, Wi-Fi
O S10+ é o modelo intermediário da linha premium de tablets da Samsung em 2024, posicionado entre o Tab S10 FE e o Tab S10 Ultra. Traz o chip MediaTek Dimensity 9300, um dos mais poderosos do catálogo Android, e painel AMOLED Dinâmica 2X de 12,4 polegadas com resolução 2800 x 1752 pixels — o suficiente para rodar com folga aplicativos de produtividade (Office, Google Workspace, apps de edição de PDF), jogos recentes e streaming em alta resolução. A bateria de 10.090 mAh entrega até 15 horas de autonomia, ou seja, aguenta um dia inteiro de uso intenso longe da tomada.
O diferencial da oferta são os acessórios que já vêm inclusos: a S Pen, caneta com baixa latência ideal para escrever à mão, fazer anotações em PDF, assinar documentos e desenhar; e a Capa Teclado, que traz também um trackpad e uma tecla dedicada a funções de IA — útil para quem quer transformar o tablet em laptop Android em dias que precisa trabalhar fora do escritório. Separadamente, esses dois acessórios custariam centenas de reais à parte, o que torna o pacote ainda mais atrativo pelo preço promocional.
Roda Android 14 com a interface One UI da Samsung, aceita cartão microSD para expandir os 256 GB internos e tem design fino (0,6 cm) e leve para a classe (750 g). As câmeras — duas traseiras de 13 MP e frontal de 12 MP — não são o destaque, mas dão conta de videochamadas e escaneamento de documentos sem problemas. A conectividade é Wi-Fi e Bluetooth; não há versão 5G nesta configuração.
- Tela de 12,4″ AMOLED Dinâmica 2X (2800 x 1752 pixels)
- Processador MediaTek Dimensity 9300
- 256 GB de armazenamento + 12 GB de RAM (expansível via microSD)
- Caneta S Pen e Capa Teclado com tecla AI inclusas
- Bateria de 10.090 mAh com até 15 horas de autonomia
- Câmeras traseiras duplas (13 MP) e frontal de 12 MP
- Conectividade Wi-Fi e Bluetooth
- Peso de 750 g e apenas 0,6 cm de espessura
- Android 14 com One UI
- Cor Cinza
Para quem vale a pena
O Galaxy Tab S10+ é indicado para quem quer um tablet “fazedor de tudo”: estudantes universitários que precisam anotar aulas e ler PDFs com conforto, profissionais que trabalham com documentos e reuniões em trânsito, ilustradores e designers que usam apps como Clip Studio Paint, Infinite Painter e Procreate (via alternativas Android), e também quem quer uma segunda tela grande para séries, filmes e jogos em casa. Com a Capa Teclado, atende bem quem precisa de produtividade em texto e navegação que uma tela touch sozinha não resolve.
Não é a melhor escolha para quem busca apenas um tablet simples de entretenimento — nesses casos, o Galaxy Tab S10 FE ou modelos da linha Galaxy Tab A resolvem por muito menos. Também não substitui um notebook em tarefas pesadas específicas que dependem de software Windows/macOS (como alguns programas de engenharia, contabilidade ou edição de vídeo profissional).
Perguntas frequentes
A S Pen e a Capa Teclado realmente vêm na caixa?
Sim. A oferta inclui a caneta S Pen e a Capa Teclado com tecla AI, além do cabo USB-C, carregador de parede de 15W e pino ejetor para bandeja de cartão. É um kit completo, sem necessidade de comprar os acessórios à parte.
O Galaxy Tab S10+ tem 5G?
Esta configuração é somente Wi-Fi e Bluetooth. Não há suporte a chip de celular. Para conexão fora de casa, é preciso usar roteador móvel ou compartilhamento de internet do smartphone.
Dá para usar como substituto de notebook?
Para boa parte das tarefas de produtividade (editar documentos no Office/Google Workspace, responder e-mails, ler PDFs, reuniões em Teams e Zoom, navegar na web), sim — especialmente com a Capa Teclado inclusa. Para fluxos de trabalho que dependem de software Windows ou macOS específico, ainda vale um notebook tradicional.
O armazenamento de 256 GB é suficiente?
Para a maioria dos usos é bastante confortável. Se precisar de mais, o Tab S10+ aceita cartão microSD, permitindo expandir sem gastar com modelo de maior capacidade.
Qual a diferença entre o Tab S10+ e o Tab S10 FE?
O S10+ é da linha premium: tela AMOLED Dinâmica 2X, chip top de linha (Dimensity 9300), mais RAM e os acessórios inclusos (S Pen + Capa Teclado). O S10 FE é a versão “Fan Edition”, com tela LCD, chip Exynos mais modesto e preço menor — ideal para quem só precisa de um tablet para consumo e tarefas leves.

articles.title: Les Anneaux de pouvoir inventent une prophétie sur Gandalf pour préparer sa future résurrection
articles.text:
Tout le monde ou presque a en mémoire la chute de Gandalf le Gris dans les mines de la Moria, entraîné par le Balrog. Son retour tout de blanc vêtu dans Les Deux Tours constitue l’un des moments les plus mémorables du Seigneur des anneaux. Pourtant, le roman de Tolkien règle la question en quelques lignes, tandis que les films de Peter Jackson ne s’y attardent pas beaucoup plus.
Voilà que la série Les Anneaux de pouvoir s’est penchée sur le sujet, avec un âge d’avance. En effet, l’œuvre tirée des appendices de Tolkien a glissé sa propre explication du phénomène dans le dernier épisode de la saison trois, intitulé La ruine des Hommes, mis en ligne le 25 novembre 2026 sur le site de SVOD Prime Video.
D’aucuns pourraient trouver cela curieux : après tout, la série se passe au Deuxième Âge, plusieurs millénaires avant les péripéties de Frodon et de ses camarades au Troisième Âge. Mais cela n’est guère surprenant lorsque l’on a à faire avec des êtres magiques et surnaturels – ce que sont fondamentalement les mages dans l’œuvre de Tolkien.
Attention, la suite contient des spoilers.
Gandalf reviendrait dans une version plus puissante
Dans la série Les Anneaux de pouvoir, Gandalf, joué par Daniel Weyman, évolue enfin sous sa véritable identité avant d’avoir été affublé du surnom de l’Étranger. Au dernier épisode, donc, il est conduit devant Sauron, qui est interprété par Charlie Vickers, afin de parler de l’avenir de la Terre du Milieu, de la domination du Mordor et de l’alliance qu’il serait possible de nouer.
Concrètement, Sauron propose à Gandalf de dominer l’Ouest du monde et à Pallando (incarné par Ciarán Hinds), l’un des deux Mages bleus de Tolkien, passé du côté de Sauron dans cette version, l’Est. Gandalf ne se laisse pas séduire par ces perspectives de découpage du monde, et rejette les offres de coopération du seigneur des ténèbres.
Ce dernier, évidemment, goutte peu à l’idée qu’on lui résiste et arme son bras pour le tuer, quand Pallando intervient. Selon lui, il serait malavisé de se débarrasser de ce mage ainsi. D’abord, cela reviendrait à renoncer aux pouvoirs d’un des cinq mages. Ensuite, cela risquerait surtout d’engendrer une menace plus sérieuse encore dans le futur.
Gandalf, qui ne se trouve plus dans la salle, devient alors l’objet d’une discussion entre Pallando, Sauron et Khamûl, l’un des futurs Nazgûl, les spectres de l’Anneau unique. Khamûl prétend que Pallando et Gandalf sont secrètement alliés, d’où l’intervention du premier pour sauver le seconde. Mais Pallando avance une explication :
Si Sauron a accepté d’épargner Gandalf, c’est parce qu’il sait au fond de lui « que le tuer ne ferait qu’inviter son esprit à revenir sous une forme plus puissante que celle dans laquelle il se drape maintenant ». L’allusion est évidente : aujourd’hui, Gandalf se drape de haillons grisâtres. Demain, il pourrait revenir dans une étoffe immaculée.
Sauron, qui est une créature surnaturelle similaire aux mages, sait sans doute de quoi on parle : derrière son enveloppe charnelle, le magicien est en fait un Maia, une sorte d’ange dans la mythologie de Tolkien, dont le vrai nom est Olórin. En somme, Pallando délivre une sorte de prophétie, qui dessine déjà ce que deviendra plus tard Gandalf.
Pourquoi Gandalf revient-il en blanc ?
Chez Tolkien, la réponse vient en deux temps. Dans Les Deux Tours, Gandalf raconte qu’il a été « renvoyé » jusqu’à ce que sa tâche soit accomplie. Il prend aussi la place de Saroumane, passé à l’ennemi, à la tête de l’ordre des mages, d’où le changement de couleur (Saroumane a aussi porté du blanc).
L’écrivain détaille ensuite ce qui s’est passé dans une lettre de novembre 1954 adressée au jésuite Robert Murray, la n° 156 de sa correspondance publiée. D’après cette lettre, Gandalf est bien mort, et ce qui le renvoie se situe au-dessus des Valar, les puissances qui gouvernent le monde, qui sont plus puissantes que les Maiar.
Il est dit qu’Eru Ilúvatar, le dieu créateur, a « accepté » le sacrifice du magicien et l’a renvoyé « grandi », selon les mots de Tolkien.
La série reprend cette lecture et l’avance d’un âge entier. Surtout, elle la rattache au Feu Secret que Gandalf dit servir face au Balrog, la flamme créatrice d’Eru Ilúvatar qui donne au magicien sa force et qui sert de titre au troisième épisode de la saison. Ce qu’elle invente vraiment, c’est le personnage qui fait l’annonce.
Tolkien n’a presque rien écrit sur les deux mages bleus, partis vers l’Est, et faire de Pallando un mage noir qui prédit l’avenir de Gandalf est une idée de la série. Il faut aussi rappeler que chez Tolkien, les mages n’arrivent en Terre du Milieu que vers l’an 1000 du Troisième Âge, ce qui a causé un fort débat chez les puristes de Tolkien.
Montrer Gandalf face à Sauron au Deuxième Âge reste donc l’une des plus grosses libertés de cette adaptation.

articles.title: La Ley de Propiedad Horizontal lo confirma: si un vecino o la comunidad deciden instalar cámaras en zonas comunes, puedes apelar al artículo 17.3
articles.text:
Instalar cámaras de vigilancia en las zonas comunes de un edificio no es algo que pueda decidir un vecino por su cuenta, ni siquiera la comunidad de vecinos si no hay una votación con una mayoría concreta. Así lo recoge el artículo 17.3 de la Ley de Propiedad Horizontal, al que puedes apelar si alguien las pone sin ese respaldo.
Qué dice el artículo 17.3. Este apartado de la Ley de Propiedad Horizontal incluye la vigilancia entre los servicios comunes de interés general y lo dice de esta manera: “El establecimiento o supresión de los servicios de portería, conserjería, vigilancia u otros servicios comunes de interés general, supongan o no modificación del título constitutivo o de los estatutos, requerirán el voto favorable de las tres quintas partes del total de los propietarios que, a su vez, representen las tres quintas partes de las cuotas de participación”.
Dos mayorías a la vez. Esto significa que la instalación tiene que aprobarse en la junta de propietarios y que el recuento se hace dos veces, por número de propietarios y por cuotas de participación. Vamos, que no basta con reunir a tres de cada cinco propietarios si entre todos no suman también tres quintas partes de las cuotas. Eso sí, esa mayoría es el primer requisito, pero no el único.
Hacia dónde pueden apuntar. Pero aunque la junta dé su aprobación, las cámaras no pueden grabar cualquier cosa. La Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD) aclara en sus preguntas frecuentes sobre comunidades que “no podrán captarse imágenes de la vía pública a excepción de una franja mínima de los accesos al inmueble”, ni tampoco “imágenes de terrenos y viviendas colindantes o de cualquier otro espacio ajeno”.
Así que, salga la idea de un vecino o de la comunidad, el paso por la junta es obligatorio, porque la ficha de la AEPD sobre cámaras en comunidades recuerda que “para la instalación de cámaras en zonas comunes será necesario el acuerdo de la Junta de Propietarios”.
